title: Tenure Discount on the Paloma Business Monthly Fee
content:
The monthly fee of a monthly-billed Paloma Business account, as billed for a billing period, receives a tenure discount: a percentage decided by the whole months since KYB approval and by the payouts that beneficiary banks confirmed as paid in the six months before the day the charge is worked out, counted from the day after the same calendar day six months earlier up to and including that day.

### Discount clause

An account approved at least 24 whole months earlier with 30 or more paid payouts in that window receives a tenure discount of 10 percent; an account approved at least 24 whole months earlier with 15 to 29 paid payouts in that window receives a tenure discount of 5 percent; every other account receives no tenure discount.

The fee as billed is multiplied by one minus the tenure discount over 100 and rounded half up to the cent, giving the discounted fee. The discount is a percentage of the fee as billed for the period.

### Truth table

| Approved at least 24 whole months earlier | Paid payouts in the six-month window | Tenure discount |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 30 or more | 10 percent |
| Yes | 15 to 29 | 5 percent |
| Yes | 14 or fewer | None |
| No | Any number | None |

### Records read

- The KYB approval date of the account, for the whole months since approval.
- The account's payouts with a paid record (the beneficiary bank's confirmation) dated inside the window.

### Worked figures (hypothetical)

- Charge worked out on 20 September: the window runs from 21 March through 20 September.
- A fee as billed of 129.00 USD with a tenure discount of 10 percent: 129.00 multiplied by 0.90 gives 116.10 USD.
- The same fee with 5 percent: 129.00 multiplied by 0.95 gives 122.55 USD.
- An account approved 23 whole months earlier with 40 paid payouts in the window receives no tenure discount.
